cell.$description: One Iosevka character at 14px. Space between items in a group.

inset.$description: Space between a container's edge and its content, equal on all four sides. Equal to radius.container, so inner shapes are square. See docs/decisions/0012-nesting.md.

marker.$description: Left and right padding of a marker, an inverted inline block such as the active workspace, the low battery or the table cursor. A marker is at least as wide as its line is tall, so one or two characters make a square. Markers side by side are this far apart, so the strip around and between them matches the container inset.

control.$description: Left and right padding of a control, such as a button, an input, a list row or the status line. Controls may be wider than tall.

group.$description: Two cells. Space between groups. Space inside a group is always smaller.

frame.$description: Space between the screen edge and the windows and bar on the desktop. One cell, the same as the gutter, so the frame, the bar and the windows share one rhythm. The same on every monitor.

half-line.$description: Half of space.line. The top and bottom inset of a text container, so the container is always a whole number of lines tall. See docs/decisions/0015-containers.md.

text-inset.$description: Side inset of a text container: space.half-line plus half the gap between space.line and the cap height of type.ui (about 10.3px), so text sits as far from the side as the caps sit from the top. 15.84px, rounded to 16px.

grid.$description: Type areas for knave-grid, measured in squares. A square is one leading wide and tall. Each type area fits its columns when column-count divides width + 1. Field-lines is the height of one field, in lines.

container.$description: Corner radius of containers: windows, the bar and popups. Content inside them stays square.

control.$description: Corner radius of controls and markers inside containers: radius.container minus space.inset, never below 0. See docs/decisions/0012-nesting.md.

min-size.$description: Smallest pointer target, so the mouse stays usable.

line.$description: Text line of the desktop bar. 16px because GTK's Pango box for 12px Iosevka is 16px tall, not because of the grid. The bar is desktop chrome, so it does not sit on the 21px page line.
